title: Global Dynamic Patterns of Entropy Solutions for One-dimensional Pressureless Euler System
summary: In this paper, we are concerned with the fine properties of entropy solutions of the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional pressureless Euler system, wherein the initial density $ρ_0$ is a locally finite Radon measure and the initial velocity $u_0\in L^\infty_{ρ_0}$. We employ the solution formula introduced by [F.M. Huang and Z. Wang, Comm. Math. Phys. 222(1) (2001), 117--146.] for this Cauchy problem to analyze the entropy solutions and obtain various new fine properties of entropy solutions; these can be summarized in four aspects: (i) Characteristics and initial waves for the Cauchy…
